title: AI Solution Architect
description: Location: London Contract Type: 12-month contract Day Rate: £650–£750 per day We are looking for an experienced AI Solution Architect to join our Technology team, working onsite with a Tier 1 Bank in London on an initial 12-month contract. This is a hands-on role focused on designing and delivering scalable, production-ready AI solutions within a complex financial services environment. You will work across business, product, engineering and data teams, taking solutions from initial concept through to deployment and production. You will have particular expertise in Generative AI and LLM technologies, including RAG, agentic AI, document and unstructured data processing, and machine learning. We’re looking for someone who combines strong solution architecture expertise with a pragmatic approach to security, governance, scalability and production delivery. Key Responsibilities Design end-to-end architecture for AI-enabled solutions, covering applications, data, integrations and production environments. Translate business requirements into practical, scalable technical solutions. Select appropriate AI approaches, including Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, machine learning and hybrid solutions. Define APIs, integrations and data contracts across upstream and downstream systems. Ensure security, privacy, resilience and appropriate controls are embedded into solution design. Define non-functional requirements including availability, performance, latency, scalability and cost. Support deployment, monitoring, versioning and ongoing lifecycle management of AI solutions. Work closely with engineering teams to break architecture into deliverable solutions and resolve technical challenges. Produce clear architecture documentation, designs and technical decision records. Identify opportunities to create reusable architecture patterns and components. Manage technical risks, dependencies and architectural decisions throughout delivery. Skills & Experience Essential Proven experience as a Solution Architect within complex enterprise environments. Strong experience designing end-to-end technology solutions across applications, APIs, integration and data. Good understanding of AI and Generative AI architecture, including LLMs and RAG. Experience taking solutions from initial design through to production. Strong understanding of APIs, integration patterns and data contracts. Experience defining non-functional requirements across performance, resilience, security and scalability. Strong understanding of security, privacy and controls-by-design. Ability to make pragmatic technical decisions and clearly communicate architectural trade-offs. Strong stakeholder management skills across business and technology teams. Experience working within fast-paced Agile or product-led delivery environments. Desirable Experience working within banking, capital markets or wider financial services. Experience delivering technology within highly regulated environments. Knowledge of agentic AI and AI-enabled workflow automation. Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, including deployment, monitoring, versioning and rollback. Experience designing solutions involving document processing or unstructured data. Experience creating reusable architecture patterns or frameworks. How We Work: Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, colour, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please use the designated space within the application questionnaire. This is a Contract role located in London with hybrid working. As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible. If your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you within 4 weeks. A valid UK working permit is mandatory for this role. Expectations regarding hybrid working: As we are a Service Provider and Consulting firm servicing clients, our policy for physically working from the office (which may be the clients' offices or our own offices depending on the client) aligns to what our clients' policies and expectations are and these vary. Most of our clients now require a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, 2 days from home, and accordingly this is also the minimum expectation that Delta Capita require. However, some of our clients have now moved up to 4 days and even 5 days in the office and we require candidates to be flexible to meet our client demands. Who We Are: Delta Capita Group is a global managed services, consulting, and solutions provider with a unique combination of experience in Financial Services and technology innovation capability. Our mission is to reinvent the financial services value chain providing technology-based mutualised services for financial institutions for non-differentiating services.
